newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell enters alliance with Amoco.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell enters alliance with Amoco.

text.p: Honeywell Inc said Thursday it will establish a business alliance with Amoco Corp to become Amoco's preferred supplier of automation technology worldwide.
Honeywell said the alliance will build on its relationship as preferred supplier of automation technology to Amoco Chemical and Petroleum Products in the United States.
Honeywell and Amoco will work on developing systems and applications focused on helping Amoco reduce production costs and increase yields in its plants.
Amoco said the agreement is its first global business alliance and reflects the company's desire to standardize its industrial automation worldwide for hardware, software and services.
A Honeywell spokesman estimated the value of the open-ended agreement "in the multi-million dollar" range but declined to be more specific.
